description: A modest oval of green felt, hand-worn and honest, ringed by four club chairs under one low lamp. No chip readers, no screens — just a hand-shuffled deck squared at the dealer's end and a brass tray of chips going dull with age. This is where the old-school game runs: cards dealt by hand and called aloud, so you can play it blind and never lose the thread.
name: Old-School Poker Table
